answer: Epoch Seed Rotation Identity Allocation enforces agent registration by reading a hardware timer pulse through a vibrating quartz crystal inside each node at random block intervals. When the network requests an attestation, the local daemon dips a logical quill into the current epoch state to sign its payload on a designated terrace of the consensus tree. An attacker attempting a sybil swarm must build physical hardware for every single fake identity, because software simulation cannot guess the un-precomputable physical resonance delay of the timing crystal.
